items.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
items.description: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

items.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
items.description: Around 200 emergency personnel are deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

items.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
items.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

items.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
items.description: The children were subsequently rescued from the water, police say.

items.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
items.description: The Student List has emerged from almost two years of anti-corruption protests to form the biggest challenge to Vučić's rule.

items.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
items.description: She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

items.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
items.description: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.
